summary: Earlier isolation, stale status, package edge, invalid-result fallback and missing-test issues are fixed. Remaining concerns are out-of-order event gap handling, Node builtins from browser-reachable packages, and lack of a compiled bridge build.

open_findings.trigger: Sequence 1 and 3 arrive before delayed sequence 2.
open_findings.impact: Cursor advances to 3 and permanently discards sequence 2, which may omit a message/status update.
open_findings.correction: Advance only through contiguous sequence numbers, or record a gap and reconcile from a new snapshot; test delayed/missing sequence cases.

open_findings.trigger: A browser-reachable UI/contracts package imports node:fs.
open_findings.impact: The boundary check permits Node builtins in package source that the browser can bundle.
open_findings.correction: Reject Node builtins for UI/contracts browser-reachable source and add a negative package fixture.

open_findings.trigger: The recorded run-many build target executes.
open_findings.impact: The target only builds contracts and workbench-web; the bridge still runs through tsx without a compiled build/launch check.
open_findings.correction: Add a clean compiled bridge build and launch check before describing reproducible bridge delivery.

verification_limits: Frozen install, format, lint, typecheck, tests, browser build and boundary checks pass at this source binding. Reviewer inspected ledger and ran one read-only boundary-policy probe; it did not rerun project tests. Browser E2E, compiled bridge launch, and actual OpenCode SDK/control-channel security remain unverified.
